THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Revocation of Order under Section 4 (1)

WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon(1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Act, Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with Industrial Disputes (SpecialProvisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968, dated 08.01.2013 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri LankaExtraordinary No. 1793/22 dated 18.01.2013 the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissionerof Labour dated 05.12.2012.
Mr. I. M. P. Illangasinghe, No. 261, Balagolla, Kengalla, of the one part
and
Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka, No. 500, T. B. Jayah Mawatha, Colombo 10, of the other part
was referred to Mr. V. Vimalarajah for settlement by arbitration.

AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, I, W. D. J. Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade UnionRelations do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the said Order dated 08.01.2013.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo.05th April, 2016.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
